post.originalText:
Haiku vs Sonnet vs Opus vs Opus max, who did better?
A non-scientific experiment. Four Claude runs got the exact same prompt: a tiny city inside a snow globe that gets shaken, then the snow settles back over the rooftops. One HTML file each, built with Three.js.
Top left: Haiku 5.5, ~58 min (it crashed twice trying to write the whole page in one reply)
Top right: Sonnet 5.5, 62 min
Bottom left: Opus 5.5, 36 min
Bottom right: Opus 5.5 on max effort, 39 min
Funny part: Sonnet and both Opus runs each picked a walnut base with brass trim and blurry fairy lights behind it. And both Opus runs light up a Christmas tree once the snow settles.
